title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center Arena on 1973-03-28

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix mix captures the show vividly, delivering a crystal‑clear blend of soundboard and audience.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this matrix patch, noting how the seamless blend of the SBD and audience puts listeners right in the middle of the concert with astonishing clarity. No technical flaws are mentioned, and the excitement conveyed suggests an energetic performance, even though specific song highlights aren’t cited.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 4‑5 stars and focus on the superb matrix sound; lack of musical detail keeps the rating just below a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the mix as immersive, crisp, and perfectly balanced between board and audience with no noted issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on setlist; reviewers concentrate on the audio experience rather than individual songs.
